notes_for_editor: Identity is unsettled. FFLA lists Hortense (30.87636, -94.73156) and Camden (30.92204, -94.73337) as separate gone towers in Polk County. The Central U.S. Camden page was joined to us-tx-hortense by a low-score match (merge_report matched_different_names, score 0.257), so the record's other_names 'Camden' rests on that join; us-tx-camden also exists separately. The NGS station sits about 2.5 miles south of the village, which fits the Hortense point (about 3 miles south of the Camden village point) better than the Camden point; that is our inference, not stated in any source. Decide which record owns the Camden page before publishing. Only 1935 and 1949 dates come from sources; no build date, height, staffing, fire, access or present-day condition was found in the sources read. The story's last paragraph is the required 'no source describes the site today' statement.
